// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/bundle.js
import { basename, dirname, join, resolve } from "@std/path";
import * as esbuild from "esbuild";
import { Bundle, bundle as compiler, crypto, mime } from "@vivalence/typology";

const stem = (type) => type.replace(`${mime.VENDOR}.`, "").replace(/\+javascript$/, "");
const missing = (error) => {
  if (error instanceof Deno.errors.NotFound) return null;
  throw error;
};
const VIRTUAL = /^(<[^>]+>|[a-z-]+:(?!file:\/\/))/;
const located = (name) => resolve(name.replace(/^[a-z-]+:file:\/\//, ""));
const stamped = async (path) => {
  const held = await Deno.stat(path);
  return { path, bytes: held.size, mtime: held.mtime.toISOString() };
};
const fresh = async (sources) => {
  if (!sources.length) return false;
  const now = await Promise.all(sources.map((held) => stamped(held.path).catch(missing)));
  return now.every(
    (held, index) =>
      held !== null &&
      held.bytes === sources[index].bytes &&
      held.mtime === sources[index].mtime,
  );
};
const read = (built) => ({
  text: built.outputFiles[0].text,
  read: Object.keys(built.metafile.inputs),
});

const solid = (filter, options) => ({
  name: "solid",
  setup(build) {
    build.onLoad({ filter }, async (file) => {
      const [{ transformAsync }, { default: preset }] = await Promise.all([
        import("@babel/core"),
        import("babel-preset-solid"),
      ]);
      const transformed = await transformAsync(await Deno.readTextFile(file.path), {
        filename: file.path,
        configFile: false,
        babelrc: false,
        presets: [[preset, options]],
      });
      return { contents: transformed.code, loader: "js" };
    });
  },
});
const universal = solid(/\.jsx$/, { generate: "universal", moduleName: "@opentui/solid" });
const dom = solid(/\.(jsx|dom\.solid)$/, { generate: "dom" });

export const MEMBERS = [
  "svelte",
  "svelte/animate",
  "svelte/attachments",
  "svelte/easing",
  "svelte/events",
  "svelte/internal/client",
  "svelte/internal/disclose-version",
  "svelte/internal/flags/async",
  "svelte/internal/flags/legacy",
  "svelte/internal/flags/tracing",
  "svelte/legacy",
  "svelte/motion",
  "svelte/reactivity",
  "svelte/reactivity/window",
  "svelte/store",
  "svelte/transition",
  "solid-js",
  "solid-js/store",
  "solid-js/web",
  "three",
  "@vivalence/dapper",
  "@vivalence/drapes/svelte",
];
const RUNTIME = /^(svelte|solid-js)(\/|$)/;
const member = {
  name: "member",
  setup(build) {
    build.onResolve({ filter: /^[^./]/ }, (args) => {
      if (MEMBERS.includes(args.path)) return { path: args.path, external: true };
      if (!RUNTIME.test(args.path)) return null;
      const text = `[bundler] "${args.path}" is no member — one of ${MEMBERS.join(" · ")}`;
      return { errors: [{ text }] };
    });
  },
};
const ENTRY = /^member:/;
const entries = (directory) => ({
  name: "member entries",
  setup(build) {
    build.onResolve({ filter: ENTRY }, (args) => ({
      path: args.path.replace(ENTRY, ""),
      namespace: "member",
    }));
    build.onLoad({ filter: /.*/, namespace: "member" }, (args) => ({
      contents: `export * from ${JSON.stringify(args.path)};`,
      resolveDir: directory,
      loader: "js",
    }));
  },
});
const UNMOUNT = `return { destroy: () => { target.innerHTML = ""; } };`;
const flat = (specifier) => specifier.replace(/^@/, "").replaceAll("/", ".");

export const bundle = (paladin) => {
  const mounted = (path) => paladin.scope.repository.branch(path).absolute;
  const imports = () => ({
    "@vivalence/typology": mounted("subsystems/typology/mod.client.js"),
    "@vivalence/drapes/": `${mounted("subsystems/drapes")}/`,
  });
  const origins = () => ({
    ...imports(),
    "@vivalence/dapper": mounted("subsystems/dapper/mod.js"),
    "@vivalence/drapes/svelte": mounted("subsystems/drapes/svelte/index.js"),
  });

  const compilers = {
    [mime.dom.svelte]: async (entry) => {
      const built = await compiler.svelte(entry, {
        prod: paladin.is.prod,
        imports: imports(),
        nodePaths: [paladin.scope.repository.branch("node_modules").absolute],
        plugins: [member],
      });
      return {
        text: built.outputFiles.find((output) => output.path === entry).text,
        read: Object.keys(built.metafile.inputs),
      };
    },
    [mime.tty.solid]: async (entry) =>
      read(await esbuild.build({
        entryPoints: [entry],
        bundle: true,
        format: "esm",
        platform: "neutral",
        packages: "external",
        write: false,
        metafile: true,
        plugins: [universal],
        logLevel: "silent",
      })),
    [mime.dom.solid]: async (entry) =>
      read(await esbuild.build({
        entryPoints: [entry],
        bundle: true,
        format: "esm",
        platform: "browser",
        nodePaths: [paladin.scope.repository.branch("node_modules").absolute],
        alias: {
          "@vivalence/drapes/solid": mounted("subsystems/drapes/parts.js"),
          "@vivalence/drapes": mounted("subsystems/drapes"),
          "@vivalence/typology": mounted("subsystems/typology/mod.client.js"),
        },
        loader: { ".css": "text" },
        write: false,
        metafile: true,
        plugins: [member, dom],
        logLevel: "silent",
      })),
    [mime.dom.html]: async (entry) => {
      const html = await paladin.read.text(entry);
      return {
        text: [
          `const html = ${JSON.stringify(html)};`,
          `export default (target) => { target.innerHTML = html; ${UNMOUNT} };`,
        ].join("\n"),
        read: [entry],
      };
    },
  };
  const stems = Object.keys(compilers).map(stem);
  const escaped = stems.map((held) => held.replaceAll(".", "\\.")).join("|");
  const ARTIFACT = new RegExp(`^/?[0-9a-f]{16}\\.(${escaped})\\.mjs$`);


  paladin.bundle = {
    directory: (directory, origin = null) => {
      const at = (name) => `${directory}/bundle/${name}`;

      const named = async (type, entry, name) => {
        const built = await compilers[type](entry);
        const artifact = `${directory}/${name}`;
        await paladin.write.text(artifact, built.text);
        const integrity = await crypto.digest(built.text);
        return {
          bundle: new Bundle({
            entries: [
              {
                mime: type,
                hash: integrity,
                mount: `/${name}`,
                integrity,
                bytes: built.text.length,
              },
            ],
          }),
          sources: await Promise.all(
            [...built.read.filter((held) => !VIRTUAL.test(held)).map(located), artifact].map(
              stamped,
            ),
          ),
        };
      };

      const bundle = async ({
        mime: type,
        source = null,
        entry = null,
        mount = null,
        name = null,
      }) => {
        if (!compilers[type]) {
          const known = Object.keys(compilers).join(" · ");
          throw new Error(`bundle: no row for "${type}" — one of ${known}`);
        }
        if (mount !== null) return await named(type, join(origin, mount), name);
        if (source === null && entry === null) throw new Error("bundle: source or entry required");
        const stemmed = stem(type);
        let hash = null;
        let text = null;
        if (source !== null) {
          if (!source.trim()) throw new Error("bundle: source is empty");
          hash = await crypto.digest(source);
          text = await paladin.read.text(at(`${hash.slice(0, 16)}.${stemmed}.mjs`)).catch(missing);
          if (text === null) {
            entry = at(`${hash.slice(0, 16)}.${stemmed}`);
            await paladin.write.text(entry, source);
          }
        }
        if (text === null) {
          text = (await compilers[type](entry)).text;
          hash ??= await crypto.digest(text);
          await paladin.write.text(at(`${hash.slice(0, 16)}.${stemmed}.mjs`), text);
        }
        return new Bundle({
          entries: [
            {
              mime: type,
              hash,
              mount: `/${hash.slice(0, 16)}.${stemmed}.mjs`,
              integrity: await crypto.digest(text),
              bytes: text.length,
            },
          ],
        });
      };

      const serve = async (name) => {
        const stem = name.replace(/^\//, "");
        if (!ARTIFACT.test(stem)) return null;
        const text = await paladin.read.text(at(stem)).catch(missing);
        if (text === null) return null;
        return { text, type: "text/javascript", integrity: await crypto.digest(text) };
      };

      const inspect = async (hash) => {
        for (const name of stems) {
          const text = await paladin.read.text(at(`${hash.slice(0, 16)}.${name}`)).catch(missing);
          if (text !== null) return { hash: await crypto.digest(text), source: text };
        }
        throw new Error(`bundler.inspect: no source kept for ${hash}`);
      };

      const prune = async ({ dry = false } = {}) => {
        const artifacts = await paladin.find
          .walk(ARTIFACT)(`${directory}/bundle`, 0)
          .catch(() => []);
        const described = await Promise.all(
          artifacts.map(async (artifact) => {
            const stat = await Deno.stat(artifact.absolute);
            return {
              name: artifact.absolute.slice(`${directory}/bundle/`.length),
              bytes: stat.size,
              sourced: Boolean(
                await Deno.stat(artifact.absolute.replace(/\.mjs$/, "")).catch(missing),
              ),
            };
          }),
        );
        const removed = described.filter((held) => !held.sourced);
        if (!dry) for (const held of removed) await Deno.remove(at(held.name));
        return {
          directory,
          kept: described.length - removed.length,
          removed: removed.map(({ name, bytes }) => ({ name, bytes })),
          bytes: removed.reduce((sum, held) => sum + held.bytes, 0),
        };
      };

      return { directory, bundle, fresh, serve, inspect, prune };
    },

    members: async () => {
      const built = await compiler.members(
        Object.fromEntries(MEMBERS.map((specifier) => [flat(specifier), `member:${specifier}`])),
        {
          prod: paladin.is.prod,
          imports: origins(),
          nodePaths: [paladin.scope.repository.branch("node_modules").absolute],
          plugins: [entries(paladin.scope.repository.absolute)],
        },
      );
      return {
        imports: Object.fromEntries(
          Object.entries(built.metafile.outputs)
            .filter(([, output]) => output.entryPoint !== undefined)
            .map(([path, output]) => [output.entryPoint.replace(ENTRY, ""), basename(path)]),
        ),
        files: Object.fromEntries(
          built.outputFiles.map((output) => [basename(output.path), output.text]),
        ),
      };
    },

    under: async (root) => {
      const artifacts = await paladin.find.walk(ARTIFACT)(root).catch(() => []);
      const directories = new Set(artifacts.map((artifact) => dirname(dirname(artifact.absolute))));
      return [...directories].map((directory) => paladin.bundle.directory(directory));
    },
  };
};

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/hash.js
import { crypto, hash as hashing } from "@vivalence/typology";

export const hash = (paladin) => {
  paladin.hash = {
    tree: async (root) =>
      await Promise.all(
        (await paladin.find.index(root)).map(async (file) => [
          file.path,
          await crypto.digestBytes(await Deno.readFile(`${root}/${file.path}`)),
        ]),
      ),

    fold: (marks) =>
      marks
        .toSorted(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1))
        .reduce((folded, [path, mark]) => hashing.string(folded + path + mark), hashing.string("")),
  };
};
#+end_src

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/link.js
import { dirname, fromFileUrl, isAbsolute, resolve } from "@std/path";
import * as jsonc from "@std/jsonc";
import { is, Path } from "@vivalence/typology";

export const link = (paladin) => {
  paladin.link = {
    path: (token) => {
      if (typeof token === "object" && token.file) {
        return new Path(resolve(dirname(fromFileUrl(token.file)), token.source));
      }
      const target = typeof token === "string" ? token : token.source;
      if (isAbsolute(target)) return new Path(target);
      if (target.startsWith("./") || target.startsWith("../")) {
        const cwd = Deno.env.get("INIT_CWD") ?? Deno.env.get("PWD") ?? Deno.cwd();
        return new Path(resolve(cwd, target));
      }
      return paladin.scope.repository.branch(target);
    },

    env: (node, record = null, at = "") => {
      const held = (key) =>
        key.startsWith("SECRET_") ? paladin.secret.get(key) : paladin.env.get(key);
      const blank = (value) => value === undefined || value === null || value === "";
      if (typeof node === "string") {
        const whole = /^\$\{([A-Z0-9_]+)\}$/.exec(node);
        if (whole) {
          const value = held(whole[1]);
          record?.push({ at, read: [whole[1]], unset: blank(value) ? [whole[1]] : [] });
          return value;
        }
        const keys = [...node.matchAll(/\$\{([A-Z0-9_]+)\}/g)].map((match) => match[1]);
        if (!keys.length) return node;
        const values = Object.fromEntries(keys.map((key) => [key, held(key)]));
        record?.push({ at, read: keys, unset: keys.filter((key) => blank(values[key])) });
        return node.replace(/\$\{([A-Z0-9_]+)\}/g, (_, key) => values[key] ?? "");
      }
      if (Array.isArray(node)) {
        return node.map((value, index) => paladin.link.env(value, record, `${at}[${index}]`));
      }
      if (node?.constructor === Object) {
        return Object.fromEntries(
          Object.entries(node).map(([key, value]) => [
            key,
            paladin.link.env(value, record, at ? `${at}.${key}` : key),
          ]),
        );
      }
      return node;
    },

    part: (source, value, at) => {
      const origin = source.absolute ?? source;
      if (!is.string(value)) return { held: value, from: origin };
      const record = [];
      const spoken = paladin.link.env(value, record, at);
      const unset = record.flatMap((read) => read.unset);
      if (unset.length) {
        const keys = unset.join(" ");
        const reason = `"${value}" names no file and no content`;
        throw new Error(`${origin} ${at}: ${keys} unset — ${reason}`);
      }
      if (/^\s*[[{]/.test(spoken)) return { held: jsonc.parse(spoken), from: value };
      const file = isAbsolute(spoken) ? spoken : resolve(dirname(origin), spoken);
      return { path: new Path(file), from: value };
    },
  };
};

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/vcs.js
import { dirname } from "@std/path";
import { Path } from "@vivalence/typology";

export const vcs = (paladin) => {
  paladin.vcs = {
    remote: (source) => /^(https?:|git@|ssh:)/.test(String(source ?? "")),

    clone: async (remote, destination) => {
      const attempt = async (bin, args) => {
        try {
          const { success, stderr } = await new Deno.Command(bin, { args }).output();
          return { success, stderr: new TextDecoder().decode(stderr) };
        } catch (error) {
          if (error instanceof Deno.errors.NotFound) return null;
          throw error;
        }
      };
      const target = destination.absolute ?? String(destination);
      await Deno.mkdir(dirname(target), { recursive: true });
      const jj = await attempt("jj", ["git", "clone", "--colocate", remote, target]);
      if (jj?.success) return new Path(target);
      if (jj) throw new Error(`[PALADIN] clone ${remote}: ${jj.stderr}`);
      const git = await attempt("git", ["clone", remote, target]);
      if (git?.success) return new Path(target);
      const reason = git ? git.stderr : "neither jj nor git on PATH";
      throw new Error(`[PALADIN] clone ${remote}: ${reason}`);
    },
  };
};
#+end_src

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/write.js
import fs from "fs-extra";
import { dirname, join, parse, relative } from "@std/path";
import { crypto as streaming } from "@std/crypto";
import { encodeHex } from "@std/hex";
import { mime } from "@vivalence/typology";

export const write = (paladin) => {
  paladin.write = {
    dir: (path) => fs.ensureDir(path.absolute ?? path),

    text: async (path, text) => {
      const file = path.absolute ?? path;
      await fs.ensureDir(dirname(file));
      if ((await Deno.readTextFile(file).catch(() => null)) === text) return false;
      await Deno.writeTextFile(`${file}.tmp`, text);
      await Deno.rename(`${file}.tmp`, file);
      return true;
    },

    bytes: async (path, bytes) => {
      const file = path.absolute ?? path;
      await fs.ensureDir(dirname(file));
      const held = await Deno.readFile(file).catch(() => null);
      const same = held?.length === bytes.length && held.every((byte, at) => byte === bytes[at]);
      if (same) return false;
      await Deno.writeFile(`${file}.tmp`, bytes);
      await Deno.rename(`${file}.tmp`, file);
      return true;
    },

    json: async (path, data) => {
      const file = path.absolute ?? path;
      await fs.ensureDir(dirname(file));
      await Deno.writeTextFile(file, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
    },

    jsonl: async (path, entry) => {
      const file = path.absolute ?? path;
      await fs.ensureDir(dirname(file));
      await Deno.writeTextFile(file, JSON.stringify(entry) + "\n", { append: true });
    },

    open: async (path) => {
      const file = path.absolute ?? path;
      await fs.ensureDir(dirname(file));
      return Deno.open(file, { write: true, create: true, append: true });
    },

    stream: async (path, dropped, body) => {
      const root = path.absolute ?? path;
      const seat = parse(dropped.path);
      const folder = join(root, seat.dir);
      if (relative(root, folder).startsWith("..")) {
        throw new Error(`[write] '${dropped.path}' leaves ${root}`);
      }
      await fs.ensureDir(folder);
      const partial = join(folder, `.${crypto.randomUUID()}.partial`);
      const sink = await Deno.open(partial, { create: true, write: true });
      try {
        const writing = new TransformStream({
          async transform(chunk, controller) {
            await sink.write(chunk);
            controller.enqueue(chunk);
          },
        });
        const digest = await streaming.subtle.digest("SHA-256", body.pipeThrough(writing));
        const hash = encodeHex(digest);
        const { size } = await Deno.stat(partial);
        const name = `${seat.name}.${hash.slice(0, 8)}.${mime.extension(dropped.mime)}`;
        const mount = join(folder, name);
        if (!(await fs.pathExists(mount))) await Deno.rename(partial, mount);
        return { path: relative(root, mount), mount, mime: dropped.mime, hash, bytes: size };
      } finally {
        sink.close();
        await paladin.remove.file(partial);
      }
    },
  };
};

// subsystems/paladin/prototypes/locks.js
const alive = (pid) => {
  try {
    Deno.kill(pid, "SIGURG");
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
};

export class Locks {
  constructor(paladin) {
    this.paladin = paladin;
  }

  mount(slug) {
    return this.paladin.scope.ledger.branch(`/locks/${slug}.lock`);
  }

  write(slug, record) {
    return this.paladin.write.json(this.mount(slug), record);
  }

  async read(slug) {
    const lock = await this.paladin.read.json(this.mount(slug), null);
    if (!lock) return null;
    const gone = (held) => Number.isInteger(held.pid) && !alive(held.pid);
    const exited = (held) =>
      gone(held) && held.status !== "EXITED" ? { ...held, status: "EXITED" } : held;
    if (!alive(lock.pid) || (lock.processes.length > 0 && lock.processes.every(gone))) {
      await this.remove(slug);
      return null;
    }
    return { ...lock, processes: lock.processes.map(exited) };
  }

  remove(slug) {
    return this.paladin.remove.file(this.mount(slug));
  }

  async list() {
    const home = this.paladin.scope.ledger.branch("locks").absolute;
    if (!(await Deno.stat(home).catch(() => null))) return [];
    const entries = await Array.fromAsync(Deno.readDir(home));
    const slugs = entries
      .filter((entry) => entry.name.endsWith(".lock"))
      .map((entry) => entry.name.slice(0, -".lock".length));
    const held = await Promise.all(slugs.map((slug) => this.read(slug)));
    return held.filter(Boolean);
  }
}

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/check.js
import { is, v } from "@vivalence/typology";

const WRONG = ["UNDOCUMENTED", "REQUIRED", "INVALID"];

export const check = (paladin) => {
  const result = (issues, input) => {
    const held = Array.isArray(issues) ? issues : [issues];
    held.fails = held.length > 0;
    held.throw = (EP = null) => {
      if (!held.fails) return;
      const messages = held.map((issue) => issue.message).join("; ");
      console.log(`[CONFIG.CHECK ERROR]`, { input, result: held, messages });
      throw new (EP || Error)(messages);
    };
    return held;
  };

  paladin.check = {
    wrong: WRONG,

    env: (input) => {
      const keys = Array.isArray(input) ? input : [input];
      const issues = keys
        .filter((key) => !(paladin.env.get(key) || paladin.env.secrets?.get(key)))
        .map((key) => ({
          type: "env",
          key,
          message: `Environment variable ${key} is missing`,
        }));
      return result(issues, input);
    },

    environment: (instance) => {
      const schema = instance.environment?.properties ?? {};
      const raw = (key) =>
        key.startsWith("SECRET_") ? paladin.secret.get(key) : paladin.env.get(key);
      const reading = (key) =>
        key.startsWith("SECRET_")
          ? {
              value: paladin.secret.get(key) ? "***" : null,
              stratum: paladin.secret.provenance(key),
            }
          : { value: paladin.env.get(key), stratum: paladin.env.provenance(key) };
      const invalid = (key) => {
        const held = schema[key];
        const value = raw(key);
        if (!held || is.empty(value)) return null;
        return v.faults(held, v.convert(held, value))[0]?.reason ?? null;
      };
      const shape = (key, at, held) => ({
        key,
        at,
        ...reading(key),
        describe: held?.description ?? null,
        group: held?.group ?? null,
        required: held ? !v.isOptional(held) : null,
        reason: invalid(key),
      });
      const verdict = (held, unset, reason) =>
        !held
          ? "UNDOCUMENTED"
          : !unset
            ? reason
              ? "INVALID"
              : "ok"
            : v.isOptional(held)
              ? "optional"
              : "REQUIRED";

      const read = instance.paladin.requirements.flatMap((entry) =>
        entry.read.map((key) => {
          const shaped = shape(key, entry.at, schema[key]);
          return {
            ...shaped,
            verdict: verdict(schema[key], entry.unset.includes(key), shaped.reason),
          };
        }),
      );
      const seen = new Set(read.map((held) => held.key));
      const documented = Object.entries(schema)
        .filter(([key]) => !seen.has(key))
        .map(([key, held]) => {
          const shaped = shape(key, null, held);
          const unset = is.empty(raw(key));
          return {
            ...shaped,
            verdict: shaped.reason
              ? "INVALID"
              : unset && !v.isOptional(held)
                ? "REQUIRED"
                : "documented",
          };
        });

      const verdicts = [...read, ...documented].sort(
        (a, b) => a.key.localeCompare(b.key) || (a.at ?? "").localeCompare(b.at ?? ""),
      );
      verdicts.fails = verdicts.some((held) => WRONG.includes(held.verdict));
      return verdicts;
    },

    instance: (held) => {
      const wrong = paladin.check
        .environment(held)
        .filter((entry) => WRONG.includes(entry.verdict));
      const named = new Set(wrong.map((entry) => entry.at));
      const faults = held.paladin.faults
        .filter((fault) => ![...named].some((at) => at && fault.startsWith(`${at} `)))
        .map((message) => ({ type: "instance", message }));
      const issues = wrong.map((entry) => {
        const at = entry.at ? ` at ${entry.at}` : "";
        const reason = entry.reason ? ` — ${entry.reason}` : "";
        const message = `${entry.key} ${entry.verdict}${at}${reason}`;
        return { type: "env", key: entry.key, message };
      });
      return result([...faults, ...issues], "viva instance/doctor");
    },
  };
};
#+end_src

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/control.js
export const control = (paladin) => {
  paladin.control = (controller) => {
    if (paladin.is.browser) {
      globalThis.addEventListener("pagehide", () => controller.kill("SIGTERM", "pagehide"));
    } else {
      for (const signal of ["SIGINT", "SIGQUIT", "SIGTERM"]) {
        Deno.addSignalListener(signal, () => controller.kill("SIGTERM", signal));
      }
    }
    paladin.telemetry.follow(controller);
    return controller;
  };
};

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/envfile.js
import fs from "fs-extra";
import { dirname } from "@std/path";

const MINTED = {
  SECRET_VIVA_JWT: () => btoa(String.fromCharCode(...crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(24)))),
};

export const envfile = (paladin) => {
  paladin.envfile = {
    MINTED,

    fallback: (held) => held?.default ?? "",

    entry: (key, value) => (value == null || value === "" ? `# ${key}=""` : `${key}="${value}"`),

    write: async (path, bag) => {
      const file = path.absolute ?? path;
      await fs.ensureDir(dirname(file));
      let text = (await Deno.readTextFile(file).catch(() => null)) ?? "";
      for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(bag)) {
        const entry = paladin.envfile.entry(key, value);
        const set = `(?:export[ \\t]+)?${key}[ \\t]*=.*`;
        const unset = `#[ \\t]*${key}[ \\t]*=[ \\t]*(?:""|'')?[ \\t]*`;
        const held = new RegExp(`^[ \\t]*(?:${set}|${unset})$`, "m");
        const tail = text ? text.replace(/\n*$/, "\n") : "";
        text = held.test(text) ? text.replace(held, () => entry) : `${tail}${entry}\n`;
      }
      await Deno.writeTextFile(file, text);
      return text;
    },

    mint: (schema, bag = {}) =>
      Object.fromEntries(
        Object.entries(MINTED)
          .filter(([key]) => key in (schema.properties ?? {}) && !bag[key])
          .map(([key, make]) => [key, make()]),
      ),

    scaffold: (schema) => {
      const groups = Object.groupBy(
        Object.entries(schema.properties ?? {}),
        ([, held]) => held.group ?? "other",
      );
      return Object.entries(groups)
        .flatMap(([title, entries]) => [
          `## ${title}`,
          ...entries.flatMap(([key, held]) => [
            ...(held.description ? [`# ${held.description}`] : []),
            paladin.envfile.entry(key, paladin.envfile.fallback(held)),
          ]),
          "",
        ])
        .join("\n");
    },
  };
};
#+end_src

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/find.js
import fs from "fs-extra";
import { extname, join, relative } from "@std/path";
import { is, Path, Vector } from "@vivalence/typology";
import { skip } from "./ignore.js";

const DIALECTS = [
  [
    (attrs) => is.string(attrs.description),
    (attrs) => ({ valence: attrs.description, load: "lazy" }),
  ],
  [() => true, (attrs) => attrs],
];

export const find = (paladin) => {
  paladin.find = {
    skip,

    walk: (pattern, ignore) => async (path, depth = Infinity) => {
      const wanted = pattern instanceof RegExp ? pattern : new RegExp(pattern);
      const skipped = skip(ignore);
      const search = async (directory, left) => {
        const entries = await fs.readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true });
        const found = await Promise.all(
          entries
            .filter((entry) => !skipped(entry.name))
            .map(async (entry) => {
              const file = join(directory, entry.name);
              if (entry.isDirectory()) return left > 0 ? await search(file, left - 1) : [];
              return entry.name.match(wanted) ? [file] : [];
            }),
        );
        return found.flat();
      };
      return (await search(path.absolute || path, depth)).map((file) => new Path(file));
    },

    describe: async (root, path) => {
      const stat = await Deno.stat(join(root, path)).catch(() => null);
      if (!stat?.isFile) return null;
      return {
        path,
        format: extname(path).slice(1).toLowerCase(),
        bytes: stat.size,
        mtime: stat.mtime?.toISOString() ?? null,
      };
    },

    index: async (root, ignore) => {
      const files = await paladin.find.walk(/./, ignore)(root);
      const described = await Promise.all(
        files.map((file) => paladin.find.describe(root, relative(root, file.absolute))),
      );
      return described.filter(Boolean).sort((a, b) => (a.path < b.path ? -1 : 1));
    },

    viva: (path, depth) =>
      paladin.find.walk(/\.(viva.js|viva.ts|viva.md|viva.org|viva.jsonc?)$/)(path, depth),

    json: (path, depth) => paladin.find.walk(/\.(jsonc?|json)$/)(path, depth),

    recipe: (home) => {
      const found = ["instance.viva.jsonc", "instance.viva.json"]
        .map((name) => join(home.absolute, name))
        .find(fs.existsSync);
      return found ? new Path(found) : null;
    },

    data: async (path, depth = Infinity) => {
      const files = (await paladin.find.walk(/\.(jsonc?|jsonl|js|ts|mjs)$/)(path, depth))
        .filter((file) => file.filename !== "index.js")
        .sort((a, b) => (a.absolute < b.absolute ? -1 : 1));
      const held = await Promise.all(
        files.map((file) =>
          /\.jsonl$/.test(file.absolute)
            ? paladin.read.jsonl(file)
            : /\.jsonc?$/.test(file.absolute)
              ? paladin.read.json(file)
              : paladin.read.data(file),
        ),
      );
      return held.flat();
    },

    modules: async (path, type, depth = Infinity) => {
      const sources = await paladin.find.viva(path, depth);
      const modules = await Promise.all(
        sources.map(async (source) => ({ ...(await paladin.read.viva(source)), source })),
      );
      return modules.filter((module) => module.manifest?.type === type);
    },

    primer: async (path) => {
      const primer = new Vector();
      const files = (await paladin.find.walk(/\.md$/)(path)).sort((a, b) =>
        a.absolute < b.absolute ? -1 : 1,
      );
      for (const file of files) {
        const { attrs } = await paladin.read.frontmatter(file);
        const nature = file.absolute.slice(path.absolute.length + 1).replace(/\.md$/, "");
        const sniffed = DIALECTS.find(([test]) => test(attrs))[1](attrs);
        primer.open(
          { ...sniffed, nature },
          async () => (await paladin.read.frontmatter(file)).body,
        );
      }
      return primer;
    },
  };
};
#+end_src

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/is.js
import { CurrentOS, CurrentRuntime, OperatingSystem, Runtime } from "@cross/runtime";

export const is = (paladin) => {
  paladin.is = {
    get sudo() {
      return ["SUDO"].includes(paladin.role);
    },
    get dev() {
      return paladin.mode === "DEVELOPMENT";
    },
    get prod() {
      return paladin.mode === "PRODUCTION";
    },
    get runtime() {
      return paladin.role === "RUNTIME";
    },
    get client() {
      return paladin.role === "CLIENT";
    },
    get deployed() {
      return (
        ["CLIENT"].includes(paladin.role) ||
        [Runtime.Browser].includes(CurrentRuntime)
      );
    },
    get citizen() {
      if (paladin.deployed) return false;
      return [Runtime.Deno, Runtime.Bun, Runtime.Node].includes(CurrentRuntime);
    },
    get tty() {
      return [Runtime.Deno].includes(CurrentRuntime) && Deno.stdin.isTerminal();
    },
    get browser() {
      return [Runtime.Browser].includes(CurrentRuntime);
    },
    get apple() {
      return [OperatingSystem.macOS, OperatingSystem.iOS].includes(CurrentOS);
    },
    get veryimportant() {
      return ["SUDO", "RUNTIME"].includes(paladin.role);
    },
  };
};

      const value = key.startsWith("PUBLIC_") ? paladin.env.get(key) : undefined;

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/read.js
import { cast, is } from "@vivalence/typology";
import * as jsonc from "@std/jsonc";
import { extract } from "@std/front-matter/yaml";
import { test as fronted } from "@std/front-matter/test";

export const read = (paladin) => {
  paladin.read = {
    text: async (path) => await Deno.readTextFile(path.absolute ?? path),

    bytes: async (path) => await Deno.readFile(path.absolute ?? path),

    json: async (path, fallback) => {
      try {
        return jsonc.parse(await Deno.readTextFile(path.absolute ?? path));
      } catch (error) {
        if (fallback !== undefined) return fallback;
        throw error;
      }
    },

    jsonl: async (path, fallback) => {
      try {
        const text = await Deno.readTextFile(path.absolute ?? path);
        return text.split("\n").filter(Boolean).map((entry) => JSON.parse(entry));
      } catch (error) {
        if (fallback !== undefined) return fallback;
        throw error;
      }
    },

    module: async (path) => {
      const file = path.absolute ?? path;
      return file.endsWith(".json") ? await paladin.read.json(path) : await import(file);
    },

    data: async (path) => {
      const module = await import(path.absolute ?? path);
      return module.default ?? module;
    },

    viva: async (path) => cast.viva(await paladin.read.module(path)),

    frontmatter: async (path) => {
      const text = await Deno.readTextFile(path.absolute ?? path);
      if (!fronted(text)) return { attrs: {}, body: text };
      const { attrs, body } = extract(text);
      return { attrs, body };
    },

    part: async (source, value, at) => {
      if (is.string(value) && value.startsWith("@")) return { module: value };
      const located = paladin.link.part(source, value, at);
      if (!located.path) return located.held;
      return await paladin.read.json(located.path).catch((error) => {
        const reason = error?.code === "ENOENT" ? "no such file" : error.message;
        const origin = source.absolute ?? source;
        throw new Error(`${origin} ${at}: "${value}" → ${located.path.absolute} — ${reason}`);
      });
    },
  };
};

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/scope.js
export const scope = (paladin) => {
  const scopes = new Map();

  paladin.scopes = (declarations) => {
    declarations.forEach(([name, condition, resolver]) => {
      if (scopes.has(name)) console.warn("paladin.scope overwrite");
      if (name === "ledger") delete paladin.ledger.held;
      scopes.set(name, [condition, resolver]);
    });
  };

  paladin.scope = new Proxy(
    {},
    {
      get: (_, key) => {
        const [condition, resolver] = scopes.get(key) ?? [];
        return condition?.() ? resolver?.() : undefined;
      },

      has: (_, key) => {
        const [condition] = scopes.get(key) ?? [];
        return condition?.() ?? false;
      },

      ownKeys: () => {
        return Array.from(scopes.keys()).filter((key) => {
          const [condition] = scopes.get(key) ?? [];
          return condition?.();
        });
      },
      getOwnPropertyDescriptor: (_, key) => {
        const [condition] = scopes.get(key) ?? [];
        if (condition?.()) {
          return { enumerable: true, configurable: true };
        }
      },
    },
  );
};

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/vault.js
import { dirname } from "@std/path";

const file = (path) => ({
  held: (origin) => {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync(path.absolute))[origin] ?? null;
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof Deno.errors.NotFound) return null;
      throw error;
    }
  },
  store: (origin, record) => {
    let vault = {};
    try {
      vault = JSON.parse(Deno.readTextFileSync(path.absolute));
    } catch {
      vault = {};
    }
    const { [origin]: stale, ...kept } = vault;
    const next = record === null ? kept : { ...kept, [origin]: record };
    Deno.mkdirSync(dirname(path.absolute), { recursive: true });
    Deno.writeTextFileSync(path.absolute, `${JSON.stringify(next, null, 2)}\n`, { mode: 0o600 });
    Deno.chmodSync(path.absolute, 0o600);
  },
});

const storage = (storage) => ({
  held: (origin) => JSON.parse(storage.getItem(`vault:${origin}`) ?? "null"),
  store: (origin, record) =>
    record === null
      ? storage.removeItem(`vault:${origin}`)
      : storage.setItem(`vault:${origin}`, JSON.stringify(record)),
});

const BACKENDS = [
  [() => "Deno" in globalThis, (paladin) => file(paladin.scope.credentials)],
  [() => "localStorage" in globalThis, () => storage(globalThis.localStorage)],
  [
    () => true,
    () => {
      throw new Error("[vault] no backend: neither Deno nor localStorage in globalThis");
    },
  ],
];

export const vault = (paladin) => {
  let backend = null;
  const resolved = () => (backend ??= BACKENDS.find(([present]) => present())[1](paladin));

  paladin.vault = {
    held: (origin) => resolved().held(origin),
    store: (origin, record) => resolved().store(origin, record),
  };
};

// subsystems/paladin/gestalten/belt/watch.js
const SETTLE = 200;

export const watch = (paladin) => {
  const hear = (paths, heard) => {
    const watcher = Deno.watchFs(paths);
    const changed = new Set();
    let settling = null;
    (async () => {
      for await (const event of watcher) {
        if (event.kind === "access") continue;
        for (const path of event.paths) changed.add(path);
        clearTimeout(settling);
        settling = setTimeout(() => {
          const paths = [...changed];
          changed.clear();
          heard(paths);
        }, SETTLE);
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(settling);
      watcher.close();
    };
  };

  paladin.watch = {
    directory: (path, heard) => hear(path.absolute ?? path, heard),
    files: (paths, heard) => hear(paths.map((path) => path.absolute ?? path), heard),
  };
};
